name: mcaselector
description_en: A tool to select chunks from Minecraft worlds for deletion or export.
readme_excerpt: MCA Selector An external tool to export or delete selected chunks and regions from a world save of Minecraft Java Edition. ⚠️ The only official and safe place to download MCA Selector is directly from the official GitHub repository https://github.com/Querz/mcaselector MCA Selector modifies and deletes chunks in your Minecraft world.
